title: 第238章 南冥王第237章 霜月横天
content_zh:
天碑如峰，悬于高空。
这座以信仰与功德捏造而成的天碑，朝着南边的鬼嘲峡谷，疾速飞了过去，而后猛地降落。
轰的一声！
整个南境大陆，仿佛震荡了一下。
山谷崩塌，乱石飞溅。
这处尸蛮国禁地，在天碑降落的瞬间，彻底变成了历史。
守在鬼嘲峡谷三十里外的蛮且，此刻飞向高空，望着那从天而降的灵碑，一时沉默不语。
国师颜守卿做的恶事，此刻黑枭军已经知晓。
表面上，大家都在声讨国师，恨其恶毒，骂其黑心，可多少人内心又是认可的呢？
没有鬼怪，以后大家的功勋从哪里来？
没有鬼怪，以后大家修行需要的鬼丹从哪来？
哪怕这些鬼丹身上，沾染了无辜百姓的鲜血，可又有多少人真的关心呢？
他想，或许这也是许多士卒的心声吧。
只是不管大家对鬼怪是憎是怒，是怨是喜，在颜守卿死亡之后，在鬼嘲峡谷里的鬼神陨落之后，这笼罩在尸蛮国身上的尸鬼诅咒，从此将销声匿迹。
蛮且望着那座将整个鬼嘲峡谷覆灭的天碑，眼神略微有些茫然。
从今往后，黑枭军不用再固守这千里之地，也不用再时刻提防着鬼怪的入侵。
今后，他们又该去往何处？
……
留下天碑之后，姜峰没再停留，带着狐仙儿，鹿香郎，虎宪章，继续往前。
燕飞龙的残魂，重新化作一缕白焰，悬顿在虎宪章的头顶上。

白焰之内，偶尔会闪过一道目光，带着崇拜的神色，望着走在最前面的少年身上。
连尸蛮国师如此强大的存在，都被这位给宰了，可见这位天宫行者大人，究竟有多强大。
“燕飞龙。”
姜峰的忽然点名，让燕飞龙心神一颤，连忙应声道：“大人！小的在呢。”
白焰在空中凝成一道小人身影，对着姜峰的方向单膝跪拜，恭敬道：
“不知您有何吩咐？”
姜峰淡淡的道：“谈谈你对尸蛮国天子的看法。”
燕飞龙沉默了片刻，一时间也不明白这位大人为何有此一问，他只是在心里默默组织了一下措辞，而后缓缓说道：“当今尸蛮天子，登临帝位已有二十年，在位期间，虽没有什么大的功绩，但对待百姓还是不错的，民间对这位天子的看法，多为平庸。既非圣君，也不昏聩。”
姜峰忽然又问：“依你之见，颜守卿养鬼为祸之事，尸蛮国皇室知晓吗？”
燕飞龙沉吟道：“或许，不知吧。”
以百姓之血养鬼，这事干系太大了，若是传出去，不知要被多少人咒骂。
皇室若是真的知情，却不阻拦，只怕天下人都要反他们了。
姜峰不置可否：“那你说，我该不该去东境帝都，问一问这尸蛮天子？”
燕飞龙惊愕的看着姜峰，张了张嘴，一时有些结巴起来：“大、大人的意思是……”
这位大人该不会觉得杀一个国师还不够，想把天子也一并宰了吧？
那尸蛮国只怕要天下大乱！
姜峰平静道：“我并非嗜杀之人，天子有错无错，总要看过问过，才能判断。”
他转头又看向身后的狐仙儿和鹿香郎：“你们两个，走一趟东境帝都，以天宫的名义，问一问尸蛮天子。”
狐仙儿与鹿香郎彼此对视了一眼，接着对着姜峰拱手应道：“遵令。”
旋即，两人便化作流光，朝着东境大陆的方向，掠空而去。
content_en:
The sky monument is like a peak, hanging high in the sky.
This heavenly monument fabricated from faith and merit flew quickly towards the Gui Mo Canyon in the south, and then landed suddenly.
Boom!
The entire southern continent seemed to be shaken.
The valley collapsed and rocks flew.
This forbidden area of ​​the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom completely turned into history the moment the Sky Monument landed.
Man Qie, who was guarding thirty miles away from Gui Mo Canyon, flew high into the sky and looked at the spiritual monument falling from the sky, silent for a moment.
The evil deeds done by the national counselor Yan Shouqing are now known to the Black Owl Army.
On the surface, everyone is denouncing the Imperial Master, hating him for his viciousness, and scolding him for his black heart, but how many people agree with it in their hearts?
Without ghosts, where would everyone’s achievements come from in the future?
If there are no ghosts, where will the ghost elixirs we need for practice come from in the future?
Even if these ghost pills are stained with the blood of innocent people, how many people really care?
He thought that perhaps this was also the sentiment of many soldiers.
It’s just that no matter whether everyone hates or is angry about ghosts, is resentful or happy, after the death of Yan Shouqing, after the death of the ghosts and gods in the Ghost Mocking Canyon, the corpse ghost curse that has enveloped the corpse barbarian country will disappear from now on.
Man Qie looked at the sky monument that destroyed the entire Gui Mo Canyon, his eyes slightly blank.
From now on, the Black Owl Army no longer needs to guard this thousand-mile place, nor does it need to be constantly on guard against the invasion of ghosts.
Where should they go from now on?
…
After leaving the sky monument, Jiang Feng did not stop any longer and continued to move forward with Hu Xian'er, Lu Xianglang, and Tiger Charter.
Yan Feilong's remnant soul turned into a wisp of white flame again, hanging above Tiger Charter's head.
Within the white flames, a gaze would occasionally flash through, looking at the young man walking in the front with an expression of admiration.
Even such a powerful being as the Corpse Man National Master was killed by this one, which shows how powerful this Lord Tiangong Walker really is.
"Yan Feilong."
Jiang Feng's sudden roll call made Yan Feilong's heart tremble, and he quickly responded: "Sir! The young one is here."
Bai Yan formed a small figure in the air, knelt down on one knee in the direction of Jiang Feng, and said respectfully:
"I wonder what your orders are?"
Jiang Feng said calmly: "Tell me what you think of the Emperor of the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom."
Yan Feilong was silent for a moment. He didn't understand why the Lord asked this question. He just composed his words in his mind, and then said slowly: "The current Emperor of Corpse Man has been on the throne for twenty years. During his reign, although he did not have any great achievements, he treated the people well. The people's view of this Emperor is mostly mediocre. He is neither a saint nor a fool."
Jiang Feng suddenly asked again: "In your opinion, does Yan Shouqing raise ghosts as a source of disaster, and does the royal family of the Corpse Man Kingdom know about it?"
Yan Feilong muttered: "Maybe, I don't know."
Raising ghosts with the blood of common people is of great concern. If word spreads, I don't know how many people will curse you.
If the royal family really knew about it but didn't stop it, I'm afraid everyone in the world would turn against them.
Jiang Feng was noncommittal: "Then tell me, should I go to the Eastern Capital to question the corpse barbarian emperor?"
Yan Feilong looked at Jiang Feng in astonishment, opened his mouth, and stuttered for a moment: "S-Sir, what you mean is..."
Doesn't this lord think that killing a national master is not enough and wants to kill the emperor as well?
The corpse barbarian country is afraid that the world will be in chaos!
Jiang Feng said calmly: "I am not a bloodthirsty person. Whether the emperor is at fault or not, you have to see and inquire before you can judge."
He turned to look at Hu Xian'er and Lu Xianglang behind him: "You two, go to the Eastern Capital and ask the Emperor of the Corpse Man in the name of Tiangong."
Hu Xian'er and Lu Xianglang looked at each other, then raised their hands to Jiang Feng and said, "Follow the order."
Immediately, the two people turned into streams of light and flew through the sky in the direction of the Eastern Continent.
